channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Juan Toscano-Anderson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Juan Toscano-Anderson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson getting his first taste of the postseason tomorrow:

“Juan was built for the playoffs. ... I'm excited to see him play. More than anything, I'm excited to have him on our side.”

Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, May 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, who signed a two-year guaranteed contract today:

“I think he's got a long career ahead of him. His story is amazing.”

Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, May 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
“It’s almost like picking up the blitz in football. If you’re the running back, you’ve gotta find the free guy and go block him. It’s the same concept. And Juan is just really good at finding that free guy. Whether (Toscano-Anderson) gets the rebound or not, he’s just giving us a better chance to do so.”

Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, Mar 4, 2021. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Mychal Mulder on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Mychal Mulder on Juan Toscano-Anderson:

“Juan plays like a guy who's starving. That's something that I really respect.”

Mychal Mulder on Juan Toscano-Anderson, Feb 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on KNBR yesterday:

“We like versatility, and Juan (Toscano-Anderson) is all about versatility. I don't know what position he plays. He's just a basketball player. I love having him out there because whatever group he's out there with -- he's gonna make better.”

Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, Feb 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on the Warriors waiving Juan Toscano-Anderson:

“Very very difficult decision for us. Juan is a favorite of mine because he knows how to play basketball and he's a winner. He just makes plays and competes.”

Steve Kerr on Juan Toscano-Anderson, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.
